name: Jindal Hotels Limited
about: Jindal Hotels Limited operates a business hotel in India. The company operates Grand Mercure Vadodara Surya Palace, a 3-star category hotel located in Vadodara; and Azure restaurant. Its hotel facilities include guest rooms, large and medium banquet halls, a boardroom, restaurant, swimming pool, health club, liquor shop, and other amenities. The company serves MNCs, corporates, PSUs, and private sector units. Jindal Hotels Limited was incorporated in 1984 and is based in Vadodara, India.
